tool_args.rationale: The pilot is monotone and concave, but its nearly constant sink gradient confounds the siphon parameters. The discriminating probe supplies the wide-gradient leverage needed to fit the branch and parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon model to pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho poorly identifiable and risks inaccurate extrapolation.
The ambiguity concerns gradient leverage and branch identification, not trajectory resolution.
It is irrelevant to the identified ambiguity.
